coordinate_convention: Original source pixels x-right y-down; partial observed silhouette arcs, not exact 3D material correspondences.
annotation_method: Independent manual inspection of original source images only. No rendered CAD outline, model pose or fit residual was used to place labels.

label_encoding.1: known foreground belonging to stated arm
label_encoding.2: known background; visible tissue/support not that arm

mask_policy: Raster masks contain only small disks around explicitly reviewed foreground/background points. Everything else remains ignore, including unenclosed contours. Boundary polylines are separate visible-silhouette observations with stated uncertainty.

limits: Partial masks do not represent full tool silhouettes or complete pixel ground truth.
Do not close missing boundary arcs through occlusion, tool junctions, blurred reflected shafts or the optical vignette.
PSM2 uses surrogate CAD; jaw opening while holding the omitted needle may differ from replay joints.
Repeated own-tool views share camera-to-tool geometry and are correlated.
Existing SAM/SurgicalSAM outputs refer to the different213709/213729 recording and are not reused.
boundary_semantics: Visible outer silhouette of the stated instrument union only. Interior cap seams, shaft/head overlap joins and same-arm part seams are omitted. Part labels describe the observed region and allow excluding jaw geometry from calibration.
review_notes: Source-only enlarged review explicitly corrected shiny PSM2 cap seams to the wider dark instrument exterior.
No inferred contour connects separated visible fragments. Unlabelled pixels, reflected shaft interiors and enclosed polygon areas are ignored, not background.
Reserved frames were inspected to place observations but remain excluded from calibration objectives. Prior diagnostic exposure means this is not a blind benchmark.
original_image_sources_note: Logical annotation sources; replay images are in images/.
